spotlight.title: Both real V2 leads are out of Frankie's licensed area — it's a targeting problem now
spotlight.detail: Linda Hansink (WA, +1 425-830-5314, lhansink@yahoo.com) came through the $300 Plan form at 10:03 PM CT Sep 7 — flagged "WA OUT OF LICENSED AREA," exactly like Nadine Dickens (TX, "NO ONE CAN") the day before. That's two-for-two: every authentic lead the campaign has produced sits outside the states you can write in. Narrow the form/campaign geo to your licensed states before spending more, and decide refer-out-or-drop on both by hand.

spotlight.title: A third lead never reached the inbox — n8n is dropping traffic
spotlight.detail: The watchdog repeated it all morning (04:09, 07:08, 12:08 Z): a Sep 6 "Gap math new" $300-plan lead reached Meta but triggered ZERO n8n runs — the automation never fired for it. Plus 4 failed runs + a 10-hour quiet gap Sep 7. The new form almost certainly has a form ID the capture webhook / "Meta $300 Plan Leads" Sheet was never subscribed to. Wire it and prove it with one real submit.

spotlight.title: Compliance still 0/7 — and now it has real names attached
spotlight.detail: b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration) and b7 (CA producer license #) are still open on day 9 of live dialing. Close both gates or write the one-line rule scoping who may be dialed — the campaign is barely spending ($0.60 today), so this is the cheapest possible window to fix it.
